limits: Zero records found meet the strict bar of being simultaneously new, human-species-confirmed, purified-enzyme and primary-value-inspected. Every ledger row is marked strict_new_biochemical_holdout_eligible = 'no'.

The MRK-952 dossier does not state the assay species or protein construct, so those records cannot enter a species-confirmed holdout until confirmed from a primary source. This is an explicit blocking condition in the evaluation design.
The SGC dossier is direct producer evidence, not a peer-reviewed dedicated MRK-952 assay publication; the 2026 degrader paper describes that work as forthcoming.
The SGC page's prose 'IC50' and its figure's 'EC50' labels disagree; both are recorded separately and must not be treated as two independent observations.
MRK-952-NC must not be used as an inactive decoy: it is a weak inhibitor, and its stereochemistry is explicitly 'assumed' by the source.

Publisher paywalls blocked full text and supporting information for 10.1021/acs.jmedchem.6b01786 and 10.1002/cmdc.201800398, including the latter's Table_1.xlsx / Table_2.xlsx proteomics tables that would resolve the Kinobead measurements. These are access limits, not evidence of absence; those rows remain database-supported and primary-value-not-inspected.
Two Europe PMC full-text fetches returned HTTP 500 and one ACS supplement returned an HTTP 202 reCAPTCHA interstitial; these were worked around via Europe PMC XML or publisher pages where possible.

Not searched at all: patents, PubChem BioAssay deposits, thesis repositories, non-English literature, vendor screening-library data, and 533 of the 633 broad Europe PMC hits. Any may contain further records.
The targeted Europe PMC query (58 hits, all 58 retrieved) is bounded, not an exhaustive census of public NUDT5 literature.

Novelty/overlap was computed only against the 14 unique Balikci ChEMBL graphs retrieved here. It was NOT computed against the repository's 45 structures or the original 23-compound source CSV, because no repository file was inspected; repository_overlap is recorded as 'not assessed' and must be recomputed before any external-test claim.

The primary proposed test is a single disjoint pair, so it can falsify a potency-discrimination claim but cannot confirm one (coin-flip probability 0.5). The design cannot estimate AUC, enrichment, precision, calibration or generalization.

Source independence is not the same as scaffold independence or never-before-inspected data; TH5427 and the EUbOPEN row are explicitly flagged as pre-inspected reference context rather than new evidence.
Cell-viability IC50 values from the docking/MD literature (2020, 2022, 2025 papers) are deliberately excluded; importing them as biochemical labels would inflate apparent external validation.

No repository was read or edited, no commit/PR/session/deposit/outreach occurred, no model was trained, and no data selection was optimized. Nothing here supports any claim about acceptance, publication, or prospective success.
